senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="M00712">same</cite> <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 30:33">Targ. Y. Ex. XXX, 33</cite> (h. text <he>ירקח</he>).
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 9:2">Targ. Prov. IX, 2</cite>. Targ. II Esth. I, 8; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 60a:11">B. Mets. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>מַזְגֵּיה טעמיה וכ׳</he> he mixed it, (and) when he tasted it &c.

<cite ref="Eruvin 54a:22">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>אשכחיה … דקא מָזֵיג ליה וכ׳</he> he found his servant when he was about to mix the wine for him; <he>אִימְזְגֵיה אנא</he> I will mix it myself; <cite ref="Nedarim 55a:7">Ned. 55ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite> (<he>חד מאת׳</he> 6) (in an enigma) <he>תרין מַזְגִּין</he> two give drink (the breasts).

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 45">Ex. R. s. 45</cite> <he>תרין אפין מזגין וכ׳</he> two angry faces putting hot water into the drink!, i.e. one adding to the other’s wrath, instead of placating; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 25:6">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXV, 4</cite> <he>מרגזין רתחין</he> (corr. acc.; cmp.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3">Deut. R. s. 3</cite>). [<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28">Lev. R. s. 28</cite>, end <he>מזגיה</he>, v. <cite ref="A00968"><he>אֲזִי</he></cite>.] <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63">Gen. R. s. 63</cite> (read:] <he>מַזְגָּהּ קדמיהון</he>, and tempered the bath before them (v. <cite ref="N01109"><he>נְצַח</he></cite>); a. e.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M00713"><he>מָזִיג</he></cite>, <cite ref="M00748"><he>מְזִיגָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 81b:11">Yoma 81ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ מי אמרי</he> Ar. (ed. <he>מזוג</he>) did I say, ‘tempered’ (vinegar)?

senses.gloss: same, esp. to mix drugs. Part. מַמְזִיג apothecary.
